_doc: A11 offline incident data (source of truth for section 36.9 and the offline simulator). Rendered by gdd/tools/render_incidents.py.

incidents.name: Karenosaurus Manager Marathon
incidents.text: {employee} was asked for the manager {n} times by a Karenosaurus and has now memorized her opinion on napkin texture.
incidents.subject: ROLE_MANAGER

incidents.name: Meatball Food Fight
incidents.text: One meatball was thrown. Then {n} meatballs were thrown. {employee} is still finding them.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CLEANER

incidents.name: Goblin Dine-and-Dash
incidents.text: {n} Impatient Goblins sprinted out before paying. {employee} chased them to the corner, then waved.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Chaos Gremlin Glitter Bomb
incidents.text: A perfectly happy Chaos Gremlin set off a glitter bomb anyway. {employee} sparkles now. Permanently.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CLEANER

incidents.name: Pigeon Flex Incident
incidents.text: A Bodybuilder Pigeon flexed so hard {n} table(s) gave up. Nobody was hurt; the tables were embarrassed.
incidents.subject: ROLE_SECURITY

incidents.name: Drama Llama Monologue
incidents.text: A Drama Llama performed a monologue about lukewarm soup. {n} customers left before the second act.
incidents.subject: ROLE_MANAGER

incidents.name: Toddler Titan Stomp
incidents.text: A Toddler Titan wanted the blue cup. There was no blue cup. {n} chairs were stomped flat (they bounced back, mostly).
incidents.subject: ROLE_SECURITY

incidents.name: Wrong Table Waltz
incidents.trigger: Tier ≥ 3 and ≥ 1 Waiter; weight ×(1.5 − avg waiter Accuracy/100)
incidents.text: {employee} delivered {n} orders to the wrong table. The wrong tables said thank you.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Polite Demon, Provoked
incidents.text: A Polite Demon stayed polite until someone took the last ketchup. {employee} apologised {n} times; the ninth one worked.
incidents.subject: ROLE_SECURITY

incidents.name: Chair Domino Effect
incidents.text: {n} chairs fell over like dominoes. {employee} called it modern art and left them for later.
incidents.subject: ROLE_REPAIR

incidents.name: Wobbly Table Uprising
incidents.text: Every table started wobbling at once. {employee} fixed {n} of them with folded napkins.
incidents.subject: ROLE_REPAIR

incidents.name: Sauce on the Ceiling
incidents.text: Nobody knows how the sauce reached the ceiling. {employee} has {n} theories.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CLEANER

incidents.name: Booth Cushion Blowout
incidents.text: A booth cushion exploded into {n} feathers. The customer sitting on it gave us five stars.
incidents.subject: ROLE_REPAIR

incidents.name: Grill Soot Sneeze
incidents.trigger: Menu uses `STN_GRILL`; weight ×1.5 if a Grill Master cooks
incidents.text: The grill sneezed a soot cloud. {employee} now has a cartoon soot mustache and {n} extra-crispy patties.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Fryer Bubble Volcano
incidents.text: The fryer bubbled over like a tiny volcano. {employee} rescued {n} baskets of fries.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Fridge Door Left Ajar
incidents.text: Someone left the fridge open. {n} units of special stock got chilly feelings and had to go.
incidents.subject: ROLE_STOCKER

incidents.name: Blender Rebellion
incidents.text: The blender refused to blend and started a slow clap instead. {employee} unplugged it {n} times.
incidents.subject: ROLE_REPAIR

incidents.name: Ice Cream Machine "Cleaning Cycle"
incidents.text: The ice cream machine announced a cleaning cycle lasting {n} hours. Nobody believed it.
incidents.subject: ROLE_REPAIR

incidents.name: Dish Station Foam Party
incidents.text: The dishwasher made {n} cubic studs of foam. Three customers asked if it was dessert.
incidents.subject: ROLE_DISH

incidents.name: Power Flicker
incidents.text: The lights flickered {n} times. {employee} kept cooking by the glow of a Jellyfish customer.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Pickle Avalanche
incidents.trigger: `EMP_001` Ollie is working (signature "Eight Arms, One Brain Cell")
incidents.text: {employee} put a pickle on {n} milkshakes. Two customers ordered seconds.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Dropped Tray Symphony
incidents.text: {employee} dropped a tray. It played {n} distinct musical notes. A Mime Mantis applauded silently.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Unscheduled Nap
incidents.trigger: Any employee's Energy < 40 % during a step
incidents.text: {employee} took a {n}-minute nap in the pantry, hugging a bag of buns.
incidents.subject: lowest_energy

incidents.name: Snack Break Became a Picnic
incidents.text: {employee}'s snack break turned into a picnic for {n}. There were tiny sandwiches.
incidents.subject: personality:Snack Goblin

incidents.name: Wrong Recipe, Right Vibes
incidents.text: {employee} cooked the wrong recipe {n} times. Customers called it the special.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Flame-Kissed Batch
incidents.trigger: A Grill Master chef is working
incidents.text: {employee} got a little too excited with the flames. {n} burgers are now extra smoky.
incidents.subject: trait:Grill Master

incidents.name: Pineapple Pizza Debate
incidents.text: The staff argued about Pineapple Pizza (Controversial) for {n} minutes. No winner. Several sulks.
incidents.subject: ROLE_MANAGER

incidents.name: Majestic Pace Personal Best
incidents.text: {employee} washed exactly {n} plates. Personal best! Everyone clapped. Slowly.
incidents.subject: trait:Unhurried

incidents.name: Grumbly Shift
incidents.text: The team grumbled through the shift. {employee} sighed {n} times per order.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Delivery Truck Took the Scenic Route
incidents.text: The ingredient truck detoured through the Sewers. {n} dishes were SOLD OUT for an hour.
incidents.subject: ROLE_STOCKER

incidents.name: Ratbeard's "Borrowing"
incidents.trigger: Tier ≥ 3; special stock on menu (else −0.02·Rh instead)
incidents.text: King Ratbeard's minions borrowed {n} crates and left an IOU written in cheese.
incidents.subject: ROLE_SECURITY

incidents.name: Bun Shortage
incidents.text: We ran out of buns. {employee} served {n} burgers between two slices of pizza. Reviews: mixed.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Supplier Discount Day
incidents.text: {employee} haggled the supplier down {n} %. The supplier is still confused about how.
incidents.subject: ROLE_STOCKER

incidents.name: Surprise Lunch Rush
incidents.text: A surprise rush of {n} hungry mutants arrived at once. {employee} handled it like a pro.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Rush Overwhelm
incidents.text: A rush of {n} customers hit a full house. Some waited outside, practicing their complaints.
incidents.subject: ROLE_MANAGER

incidents.name: Alien Tour Bus
incidents.trigger: Tier ≥ 4, headroom ≥ 10 %; weight ×3 if `EVT_018` overlaps the interval
incidents.text: Zorp's tour bus parked outside. {n} Alien Tourists ordered one of everything, in Earth sizes.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Birthday Beast Party
incidents.text: A Birthday Beast brought {n} friends. Cake eaten, confetti everywhere, tips huge.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Rainy-Day Lull
incidents.text: It rained {n} different flavors of weather. Customers stayed home.
incidents.subject: ROLE_MANAGER

incidents.name: Accidentally Viral Patty Flip
incidents.text: An Influencer filmed {employee} flipping a patty. {n} thousand views, mostly from her mom.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Baron's Coupon Blitz
incidents.text: Baron Von Bistro handed out {n} coupons for Le Fancy Fin right outside our door. Rude. Effective.
incidents.subject: ROLE_MANAGER

incidents.name: Midnight Pancake Crowd
incidents.trigger: Interval covers 00:00–04:00 UTC; weight ×1.5 per Night Owl working
incidents.text: At midnight {n} sleepy mutants shuffled in for pancakes. {employee} served them in pajamas.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Inspection: Sparkling!
incidents.text: Inspector Grimewell ran a white glove over {n} surfaces and found nothing. He looked disappointed. We got a gold star.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CLEANER

incidents.name: Inspection: Sticky Situation
incidents.text: Inspector Grimewell's shoe stuck to the floor for {n} seconds. He wrote a very long note.
incidents.subject: ROLE_MANAGER

incidents.name: Undercover Taster Approves
incidents.text: An Undercover Inspector in a very obvious fake mustache loved dish number {n}.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Undercover Taster Unimpressed
incidents.text: An Undercover Inspector called our food fine. {employee} has stared at a wall for {n} minutes.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Vlogzilla Drops In
incidents.text: Vlogzilla livestreamed lunch here. {n} thousand viewers are now hungry.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Madame Fourchette's Secret Visit
incidents.text: Madame Fourchette visited in disguise (a giraffe in a trench coat is not a disguise). She wrote {n} words. Most were nice.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Wrestler Walrus Fan Meetup
incidents.text: A Retired Wrestler Walrus signed {n} napkins and one very surprised chair.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Rich Mutant Big Tipper
incidents.text: A Rich Mutant tipped {n} shiny coins and a monocle. We kept the coins.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Omnivora Sniffs the Air
incidents.text: Chef Supreme Omnivora walked past, sniffed, and nodded {n} times. The kitchen hasn't stopped grinning.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Brawl Stopped Cold
incidents.text: {employee} stopped {n} angry customers with one very stern eyebrow.
incidents.subject: ROLE_SECURITY

incidents.name: Grill Saved Mid-Sizzle
incidents.trigger: ≥ 1 Repair Technician working; also cancels one equipment incident in the same report
incidents.text: {employee} fixed the grill mid-sizzle. {n} patties were saved and are grateful.
incidents.subject: ROLE_REPAIR

incidents.name: Cake Catch of the Century
incidents.trigger: A Waiter with Speedster, Grabby or Flying is working
incidents.text: {employee} caught a falling birthday cake {n} centimeters from the floor. Standing ovation.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Accidental Masterpiece
incidents.trigger: A Chef with Cooking ≥ 60 is working
incidents.text: {employee} invented a new special by accident: {n} burgers stacked sideways. It sold out.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Manager Pep Talk
incidents.text: {employee} gave a pep talk so inspiring that {n} staff high-fived the fryer (carefully).
incidents.subject: ROLE_MANAGER

incidents.name: Plate Mountain Conquered
incidents.text: {employee} washed a mountain of {n} plates. There is a tiny flag on top now.
incidents.subject: ROLE_DISH

incidents.name: Slip-Apocalypse Averted
incidents.text: {employee} mopped a soup spill seconds before {n} customers walked through it.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CLEANER

incidents.name: Delivery Speedrun
incidents.text: {employee} delivered {n} orders before the food realized it had left.
incidents.subject: ROLE_DELIVERY

incidents.name: Secret Pantry Stash
incidents.trigger: ≥ 1 Stocker working; special stock +3 units (or +0.02·Rh if no special recipe)
incidents.text: {employee} found {n} forgotten crates behind the pantry. One was labeled Nana's Emergency Stardust.
incidents.subject: ROLE_STOCKER

incidents.name: Shards in the Couch
incidents.text: {employee} found {n} Mutation Shards in the booth cushions.
incidents.subject: any

incidents.name: Glowing Puddle
incidents.text: A puddle in the alley glowed. {employee} scooped out {n} Mutation Shards (and a sock).
incidents.subject: any

incidents.name: Mystery Crate on the Doorstep
incidents.text: A crate appeared on the doorstep with a note: From a fan. Inside: {n} units of something rare.
incidents.subject: any

incidents.name: Capsule in the Lost & Found
incidents.trigger: Capsule roll succeeded (≤ 1 per UTC day)
incidents.text: {employee} found a Morph Capsule in the Lost & Found. Nobody claimed it, so it's yours!
incidents.subject: any

incidents.name: Upside-Down Hour
incidents.text: For {n} minutes gravity got confused. {employee} served soup to the ceiling. The ceiling was satisfied.
incidents.subject: ROLE_WAITER

incidents.name: Haunted Toaster Order
incidents.text: A Haunted Toaster ordered {n} slices of toast. It was very awkward for everyone.
incidents.subject: ROLE_CHEF

incidents.name: Time-Traveler Tip
incidents.text: A Time-Traveler Tortoise paid with money from {n} years in the future. The bank says it's fine. Somehow.
incidents.subject: any

incidents.name: Pigeon Parliament
incidents.text: {n} pigeons held a meeting on the roof. They voted to like us.
incidents.subject: any

incidents.name: Lost Pet Kraken
incidents.text: A lost baby kraken wandered in, hugged {n} tables and tipped generously (in fish).
incidents.subject: any

incidents.name: Pickle Rain Windfall
incidents.text: It rained pickles. {employee} caught {n} in a bucket. Pickle Mountain Burger is free for staff today.
incidents.subject: any
